title: ☄️ A Mountain-Sized Asteroid Will Pass Near Earth in 2027... About a Moon's Distance Away!
body: ☄️ A Mountain-Sized Asteroid Will Pass Near Earth in 2027... About a Moon's Distance Away!

A huge asteroid called 1999 AN10 will pass near Earth on August 7, 2027, at a distance of about 390,000 kilometers, roughly the distance between Earth and the Moon. It is between 800 and 1,800 meters wide, the size of a mountain, and has been classified as a "potentially hazardous" asteroid because of its size and proximity, but calculations confirm there is no chance of it colliding with Earth in 2027.

The asteroid will be bright enough to see with ordinary binoculars from North and South America, reaching magnitude 7.3, with its closest approach at 07:12 GMT, and it will cross the constellations Taurus, Aries, Pisces, and Pegasus during the night. The Moon itself will not be near it, as it will be on the other side of Earth.

This is the closest pass of an asteroid this size since 1918, and a rare chance to study a large space rock up close, as it moves at about 26 kilometers per second around the Sun, completing a full orbit every 643 days.
Simply put: a mountain-sized rock will pass by us at the Moon's distance, and it can be seen with binoculars; will you follow this rare event in the summer of 2027?
